issues.quote: revenue rising 9.6% to $391.0 billion from $383.3 billion
issues.problem: The growth rate is wrong. Going from $383.3B to $391.0B is about 2.0% growth, not 9.6%.

data.summary: Every figure matches Apple's FY2023 and FY2024 results except the revenue growth rate. It is stated as 9.6% but is actually about 2.0%.
